question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who do you think Ben should date?
Which date did you like the best?

nodes.text: Nicole sighs and looks back to the ocean.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry I even brought it up. Geez... You must think I'm so crazy...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think you're upset and having an off day.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nicole, you just have to remember that you are important...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You deserve to be listened to... I hope you find girl friends that you get along with.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Because you really are special.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Thanks... Sniff... No one's ever sat down and told me that before.
Ben puts a comforting arm around her.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I just hope I haven't ruined our entire night.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, not at all. It's okay. Really.
They hug.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're a really good guy. Thanks, Ben.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No problem.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...So, want to make out?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just kidding! Come on, take me home. It gets really chilly out here in the evenings.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, yeah, but you just have to remember that everyone gets crazy once in a while.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What do you mean by that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, girls tend to act crazier than guys, but you know... We just have different brain patterns.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can't believe this! You're actually calling `me` crazy!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe this! You're actually calling [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] crazy!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You asked!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Oh, I'll show you crazy! This date is over!
Nicole stands up and picks up food from their picnic basket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, wait, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No one hurts my feelings and gets away with it!
Nicole flings a sandwich at him!
Ben ducks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, hold on... I didn't mean 'crazy' in a bad way!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah right!
Nicole throws a fruit basket! Grapes, strawberries, and a stray cantaloupe piece pelts Ben's shirt.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just do me a favor and leave me alone!
In one swift move, Nicole tugs the blanket, sending the remaining food and sand flying everywhere!
She flings the blanket onto Ben, entangling him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Agh! What's going on?!
Ben struggles in the blanket. Over his shuffling, he can hear Nicole's voice.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm leaving... This was a terrible date! I hope the crabs eat your feet!
Nicole storms off the beach.
The next day...
Spencer and Ben talk as Ben makes preparations for his third date.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... How'd it go with Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: For the most part, it was fun.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We had a rough time towards the end, but then...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Things went uphill from there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're really good friends now.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh yeah? You're `good` friends? Friends with Frenching, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah? You're [color=#e23b3b][i]good[/i][/color] friends? Friends with Frenching, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, we didn't make out.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Aw, man, you're killing me. These aren't tea parties, these are dates!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It started out great, and we almost kissed...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then she started a food fight with me.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: All right! Way to go!  A food fight!
Spencer raises his hand.
Ben shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was a `bad` thing... She started throwing the sandwiches at me, and then she stormed off the beach.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was a [color=#e23b3b][i]bad[/i][/color] thing... She started throwing the sandwiches at me, and then she stormed off the beach.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I called her later that night to see if she was okay...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And that's when she told me I was a loser that she never wanted to see again.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bummer.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Maria? Really?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you two both like the Royal T's. Maybe you could hit it off.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just because we like the same music doesn't mean we'd be great friends...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it might mean you have more in common than you think.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're right, Ben. It's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry you feel so alone.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: My mom? I'm not going to share things with her!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Do you know how totally embarrassing that is?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I used to talk to my mom... Before she left us.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You talked to your mom about who you had a crush on? About who you made out with?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, it was pretty easy... Since I hadn't actually kissed anyone until after she was gone...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh... That is so unhelpful, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry. I'm not really good at this stuff.
Ben blanks.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: See? You can't even think of anyone who I'd get along with.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I just blanked out. What about your mom?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe you can be friends with...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Believe me, the cheerleading team does everything together, but that doesn't mean we're all friends.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Outside of cheerleading stuff, I don't see $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Besides, $ZOE has her life together. I can't talk to her about how messed up mine is.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So what do I do right now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So not $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: From what I actually knew about Jessica... She thought of you as her closest friend.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You both talked to each other, right?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, but she's `gone!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but she's [color=#3b78e2][i]gone![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you were `friends` with Jessica...
nodes.text_bbcode: But you were [color=#e23b3b][i]friends[/i][/color] with Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So it stands to reason that you can make more friends, if you've already made one before.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Huh... Maybe you're right...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But what do I do right now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Who were you thinking of? The other cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... What about $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's terrible! Girls feel threatened, and guys don't really care about who I am. No one bothers getting to know `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's terrible! Girls feel threatened, and guys don't really care about who I am. No one bothers getting to know [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't know what to do about it though...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I don't know what to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Except that you might get better advice if you talk to another girl about it...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But that's just it. I don't really have any friends to talk to...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't make friends. I can't keep a guy friend to save my life. It's one of the worst things about me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aren't you friends with other girls? What about...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Exactly. Most people think I'm pretty.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I was hoping you were different.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it's not an insult, is it?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Really? You think I'm nice? I'm not sure I believe you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Or did you mean `nice` like `ugly?` Girls do that a lot...
nodes.text_bbcode: Or did you mean [color=#3b78e2][i]nice[/i][/color] like [color=#3b78e2][i]ugly?[/i][/color] Girls do that a lot...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know... That makes sense. Jessica used to describe all my old clothes as 'nice'...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I definitely don't mean that you're ugly...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's the opposite. You're beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But everyone says I'm beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're, uh...
Ben's words die in his throat.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You don't have to say anything. It's fine. I'll tell you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Everyone thinks I'm `pretty...`

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Of `course` I like you... You're hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Of [color=#3b78e2][i]course[/i][/color] I like you... You're hot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...That's it?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What else is there?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Nicole turns away from him abruptly.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No, you're right! You're completely right!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm always trying to make out with guys too quickly! Even before I know if I like them...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why do you do that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I don't really know...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: According to Chic Magazine, it's the best way to figure out what a guy really thinks of you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Is he a Fab Friend, a Friend with Frenching, or just a Fried Fish...?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Or maybe I try to kiss guys quickly because I'm afraid of losing them.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: People don't really like hanging around me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That isn't true...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Isn't it? What do you suppose people think when they look at me?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Before this date, what did you think of me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What am I supposed to say to that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought you were...
Ben leans in, but at the last moment, Nicole pushes him away!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No! I don't want this!
Ben backs away quickly, lifting his hands.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa, what's wrong? Are you okay? I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I... I.... That felt weird. We `just` started talking, like, two hours ago...
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I.... That felt weird. We [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] started talking, like, two hours ago...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's too fast... Why did I even do that? Do I even like you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Do you?
Ben suddenly pulls away, causing Nicole to nearly topple over.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why don't you kiss me? Do you not like me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not that... It's just... Don't you think this is too fast?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... Probably.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've been enjoying this time with you, but...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You don't like me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, I didn't say that. I just don't usually kiss this quickly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean, we barely know each other. Do you even like me?
Ben walks away from the register. In a second, Spencer comes out, carrying a small bouquet of flowers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are those for an occasion or an apology?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Both. Kind of. More of like an 'I'm sorry I forgot that it's our one month anniversary' gift.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I see... Well, I'll see you later, Spence.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Good luck, bro.
Ben rings Nicole's doorbell. A few seconds later, Nicole flings the door open!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ben, it's so nice to see you!
She throws herself into Ben's arms.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good to see you too... And I have something for you...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooh!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll get this.
Ben buys the gift card.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hopefully, she likes music...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll get this.
Ben buys the baseball cap.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, she likes visiting colleges.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But let's forget about Jacob... I'm sorry I even brought him up...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This night is about us.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And I'm having a really good time, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know... I really like you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maria, you're great, but...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think things are going to work out between us.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It sounds like you're still hung up on Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And having just dumped Jessica... I'm still a little hung up on her too.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It just doesn't seem like a good idea to date if we're both thinking about other people when we get together.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know what? You're right. I... I am still hung up on Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I just thought he actually wanted to be with me, so when we broke up...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It didn't seem fair.
Maria gives Ben a sad smile.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, maybe someday if you get your mind off Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And if I get my mind off Jacob...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then we can try again.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben, for being honest with me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And for making this a fun night anyway.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Shall we go home?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, let me walk you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're just not the right girl for me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's not really you. It's more about me, you know?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, I don't! If it's about you, then why am I the one getting left out?
Maria bursts into tears, and Ben panics.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, wait... Don't cry... Really, you deserve someone better than me.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Better than the most popular guy in school?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're worse than Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I wish I'd never come out with you!
At that moment, the maitre d' rushes over to the table.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: What seems to be the matter, mine privateers?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nothing at all!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff... He made me... Cry!
The Captain turns an angry eye on Ben.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: You know our rules here, don't you?
The Captain points to an unfurled scroll on the wall, held in place with nails and a fake dagger.
It reads, 'Terms and Conditions for Walking the Plank'. The Captain points to number 10 on the scroll.

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: Yer the `second` lad to do this today... If ye make yer lady cry... Ye walk the plank!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yer the [color=#e23b3b][i]second[/i][/color] lad to do this today... If ye make yer lady cry... Ye walk the plank!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, I...
The Captain hauls Ben to his feet and pushes him up a steep ladder leading to a high diving platform.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No way...

nodes.speaker: Captain
nodes.text: Aye, go up there, ye landlubbing lubberman! I know a scurvy dog when I see one!
Ben walks down the edge of the plank and looks into the cold water tank below him. The Captain steps on the platform with him and pushes him over!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Agghhhhhhh!
Ben crashes into the pool with a loud splash, and everyone cheers!
When Ben comes to the surface, he looks around for Maria, but she is gone.
The next afternoon...
Ben and Spencer are at the mall.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So... How'd your date go?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know... It went okay.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At the end of the night, I felt pretty good about the entire evening.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sounds like Kale did some K-I-S-S-N-G with Maria!
Ben gives Spencer a skeptical look.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: First, there are two i's in 'kissing', and second, it wasn't like that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: After she told me she liked me, I turned her down, and then I walked her home.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You turned her down?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah. She's still hung up on Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Jacob? Like, Grumpy Baby Face Jacob?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Afraid so...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Say no more. If Maria's not into you, forget about her, move on. It didn't work out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maria and I were having an okay time talking...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And then I walked the plank.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! Harper and I have definitely `walked the plank.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! Harper and I have definitely [color=#e23b3b][i]walked the plank.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: High five, man!
Spencer puts his hand up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have no idea what you're talking about...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I don't want to.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We went to a pirate restaurant. I literally walked the plank.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We didn't kiss... We didn't even hold hands!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, forget all about Maria... So things went bad with her...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now things will definitely work out with Nicole! Are you ready for your hot beach date tonight?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: To be honest... No, I'm not ready. After what happened with Maria...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I get the feeling I should stop going out.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, man... I know how things not working out makes dating really hard...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But it's supposed to be fun. Just go out there and relax.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Besides, you know Nicole... She makes out with everyone! You can't lose!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know what your definition of 'winning' is...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, do you know what you're going to get her yet?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You could do roses... Or chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, I did that for Maria... It feels cheap to use the same thing on two different girls in a row.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I don't know that much about Nicole honestly...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, at the date auction, they said she liked music and colleges.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Music, huh? What about a gift card for her phone's music store?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A gift card? That's like giving cash.
Ben looks over and sees a hat with 'Centerscore U' on the brim.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or this?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: A hat? Why don't you just tell her that her hair is ugly to her face?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What should I get instead?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't know. You're on your own for this one...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, I'm going to get something. You can figure your stuff out, can't you?
Spencer runs off as Ben contemplates his two choices...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, he isn't! He's very caring and understanding...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But you just said...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I know what I said. And Jacob just feels he's too young to commit to anything.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And maybe he's right. Maybe no couple in high school should be that exclusive.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jacob sounds confused.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Obviously, he wanted to date you if you kept going out...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it doesn't seem like he's that into you since he couldn't make up his mind.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It must be frustrating when you know what you want, but he doesn't.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah... It definitely was.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Can I tell you a secret?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I've never told anyone this... But I want to be Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I was never considered...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It seems like I can finally have my chance now that Zoe's stepped down...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm glad for you.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're so supportive...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I try.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Jacob was never that understanding about all this stuff.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah... You keep mentioning him. Wasn't he your boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I wish!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Or, rather, I mean, I `wished.` He wasn't interested in committing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Or, rather, I mean, I [color=#3b78e2][i]wished.[/i][/color] He wasn't interested in committing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We'd gone on a lot of dates, but he didn't want to use 'labels' or anything.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: He always wanted to 'keep things open'.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jacob sounds...

options.label: Like he doesn't know what he wants.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You said you wanted to be in movies since you were little. Where did you grow up?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know, it's been a long time since anyone asked me that.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It seems like all anyone ever talks to me about is cheerleading...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Glad I didn't ask you about that then.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I came from kind of a bad background. We used to live on the other side of town!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It was a rough life. Both my parents worked late. I was home alone a lot of the time.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Movies and TV helped me think about moving away from all that.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And even though my parents and I moved to a nicer place...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It just always kind of stuck with me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm glad I got to know this side of her...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What's to say? I'm a cheerleader, and I'm pretty good at all the routines...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I am so happy that Jessica isn't Head Cheerleader anymore. You have no idea what it was like being under her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, I have some idea...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Er, yeah, of course! Sorry! I mean...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I kind of knew all this already...
Ben arrives at Maria's house and rings the doorbell. She opens the door.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hi, Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Girls like flowers...
Ben buys a bouquet of pretty pink and yellow flowers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't go wrong with chocolate...
Ben buys a heart-shaped box of chocolates.
Spencer finds the table where the cheerleaders are collecting money.
Ben runs after him. By the time Ben has made his way through the crowds, Spencer has handed the money over and is talking to Nicole, Sam, and Maria.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: ...In that case, I'm `really` looking forward to our date!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...In that case, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] looking forward to our date!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, if this really has to happen... I'm not going to back out.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: See you later, Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Bye!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on, not even for a friend?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You won't regret it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, why would you come to buy a date without any money?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Your money is in good hands, man.

nodes.speaker: Ben

I wonder what he's doing...
As Maria and Ben get seated, Hector cranes his neck around the flower pot.
This spot is perfect! I have a great view of the table Amanda and Erik are sitting at!
They're not getting away from me!
Hello, scary pirate waiter... We want the Ships and Dip appetizer...
And then I'll have the Swim with the Sharks Platter...
And I'll take the Cannon Meatball Frigate.
These names are so funny!
Behind the pot, Hector glares at Erik.
Stupid Erik...
Hector watches Amanda laugh at something Erik said.
Outbidding me at the auction...
Take my girlfriend out on a date...
But I know why you did it...
You're stealing her from under my nose!
Amanda, ever since Valentine's Day...
I wanted to tell you how I feel...
I already know!
You do?
Amanda puts her hand on Erik's shoulder.
Yes! And I have to tell you, Erik, that you are the most special bunny!
Okay, things have gone `too far!`
Hector rolls out from his hiding place and springs forward!
He dives across a table, sending glassware crashing to the ground!
Sorry, but I've got a date to crash!
Hector weaves around several people, upsetting waiters serving huge platters of food.
He storms up to the table!
Stop it right now! This date is done!
Hecky-Wecky...
Why are you so angry?
Because I know what's going on here!
You... You do?
Yeah! You're trying to confess your feelings!
Well, don't even bother! She doesn't like you back!
She doesn't?
Nope!
Erik and Amanda both look down.
Oh...
Oh no...
Sniff... Sniff... I thought Ashley really `did` like me...
Erik starts tearing up.
Me too...
Wait, the girl you like is Ashley?
Yeah... Amanda gave me good advice on Valentine's Day, and I wanted to tell her I was grateful for it.
So... You weren't planning to tell my girlfriend that you had a crush on her?
No... Sniff...
Sniff... Erik, you're making me cry...
Well, now I feel bad...
Suddenly, Hector feels himself being lifted up by a formidable pirate!
Aarrrrrrrrr! Ye should feel bad!
We have a house rule... Ye make yer lady cry... Ye walk the plank!
Whoa... Hold on... It was just a misunderstanding!
The way I misunderstand it... It looks to me like ye made `two` ladies cry!
Erik's a boy!
I do have feminine facial features...
It's off to the plank with you!
Hey, wait! No!
Amanda, explain it! Quickly!
Sorry... But you broke the rules, Hecky...
`Noooo!`
Well... Looks like Hector learned his lesson. That's what happens when you show up to angrily break up a date between your girlfriend and someone else!

nodes.text: It's a beautiful afternoon in the city of Centerscore...
The day is warm, the sun is out, the birds are singing...
And Ben is wrapped in a blanket, sadly contemplating the contents of his fridge.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm still upset about Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...When I shouldn't even be giving her a second thought!
As Ben prepares himself a sandwich...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But we'd been together for such a long time...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's almost as bad as when Denni broke up with me...
Ben takes his sandwich and walks into the lightless den, where a video game console is hooked up to the large TV.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At least this time, I have an awesome video game to get my mind off her...
He sets his sandwich down and starts playing.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Finally! The boss fight against Sandman The Social Elitist!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's taken forever to get here!
Some furious button smashing later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Just a few more hits... And you're gone!
And that's when Spencer bursts into the room, unhooks the game console, and throws a controller in Ben's face!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What the heck are you doing?! I was just about to finish him off!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm saving you from yourself, man. What have you been doing all weekend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Playing this video game.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah. Exactly. You're playing 'Sadness: The Wandering Hermit' `by yourself` in a dark room that smells like my shoes after football practice...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. Exactly. You're playing 'Sadness: The Wandering Hermit' [color=#e23b3b][i]by yourself[/i][/color] in a dark room that smells like my shoes after football practice...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You're wearing a blanket, you haven't showered, and you're surrounded by moldy food!
Ben looks over. His sandwich is covered in mold, completely rotten.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...What do you want, Spencer?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I came to get you out of here. You need to leave your house.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Or at least leave your bedroom! Do you remember when you started playing this game?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like, Friday night? I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And what time is it now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Saturday?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Try three in the afternoon on Sunday!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It's time to admit you've got a problem...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Spencer, I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No, you're not. If you were 'fine', you'd actually put shoes on in the morning...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If you were `'fine',` you wouldn't be sitting next to a furry sandwich...
nodes.text_bbcode: If you were [color=#e23b3b][i]'fine',[/i][/color] you wouldn't be sitting next to a furry sandwich...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `If you were fine`...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]If you were fine[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, I get it! I'm not 'fine' at all!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I'm not going to get over Jessica in a day. What am I supposed to do about it?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You need to go out...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: With a girl.
